QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Toward the Black Sun
QuestInfo.0: Melange showed up at the White Spear before you left.
QuestInfo.1: It's reassuring to see Melange boarding the battleship. You can use all the help you can get in the coming battle.
QuestInfo.2: The moment you entered the black sun, your ship crashed. It's difficult to tell where the path is... if there even is a path... Even your location is a mystery.
